import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
index = 0
T = int(input[index])
index += 1
results = []
for _ in range(T):
    N = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    goals = list(map(int, input[index:index + N]))
    index += N
    max_diff = -1
    min_goal = goals[0]
    for i in range(1, N):
        if goals[i] > min_goal:
            max_diff = max(max_diff, goals[i] - min_goal)
        min_goal = min(min_goal, goals[i])
    results.append(str(max_diff) if max_diff != -1 else "UNFIT")
print("\n".join(results))
